"'''Rotten to the Core (Empire's Crumbling)'''" was a [[Music/Legends|song]] by [[Deeply Religious]] from their album ''[[Advanced Explosives Handbook]]''. As one might assume, it was banned by the [[Imperial Board of Culture]].
